review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Role Summary As the Systems Engineer II – Endpoint Management , you will help keep our technology environment secure, reliable and running effectively through hands-on management of endpoints and Microsoft 365 applications. You will bring technical expertise in Microsoft Intune, SCCM and related Microsoft technologies to support our users, strengthen security and improve systems performance. Working closely with our Infrastructure and Cybersecurity teams, you will have the opportunity to define processes, influence solutions and expand your expertise across different areas of technology. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Office 365 and SCCM/MECM, including endpoint configuration, application deployment and patch management. Proficiency with PowerShell scripting and automation.
